scope: Original spiritual successor to all described story-mode RDR2 wiki content; no scope compression.

source_access.fallback: Web search indexed wiki article excerpts
source_access.limitation: Indexed text verifies named entries and sampled descriptions, not exhaustive current article contents.

implementation_status_policy: Unimplemented until independently inspected with implementation and runtime evidence; in_progress records verified partial work and open gates. Accepted/completed requires every source-specific obligation and its runtime/presentation/input audit. This inventory is not gameplay.
row_count_interpretation: Requirement rows mix titles, multipart parent entries, cinematics, variants and taxonomy parents. Do not equate row counts with a source mission total or a completion percentage.
excluded_from_unqualified_story_inventor: Online-only weapons, horse breeds, roles and multiplayer content
exclusion_policy: These are classification flags, not authorization to narrow the requested scope; resolve any edition ambiguity explicitly during source reconciliation.

requirements.notes: Nine distinct original stages have runtime implementation and independent simulation/player-control evidence. Authored contact animation and one complete automated pointer and controller path add partial evidence; source inventory/revision, full scene quality, native touch/hardware, all branch input combinations and actual later dependencies remain open. This requirement is not accepted; evidence does not claim full-game completion.

Ten original runtime stages, separate persistent northern region and cast, independent weapon/loan/clinical/attachment/replay contracts, authored contact animation, 158 passing substantive tests and actual ordinary Chromium/Firefox recovered-case and WebKit omitted-case continuation/reload evidence. Full WebKit phone-pointer and emulated Chromium-controller continuations also pass; separate public notebook controls expose the drawing and support controller scrolling. The public routes start from a game-generated current-v2 opening Save through visible Import; they are not one uninterrupted fresh two-mission run. Source revision/transcript/minor beats, exact encounter count and scoring, full branch/input/hardware/presentation acceptance and actual next missions remain open. No source acceptance or full-game completion is claimed.

gaps.description: The requested wiki and linked guide scope has not been fully traversed or pinned to article revisions. Source inventories remain open; row totals are not final source totals.

Campaign title existence is indexed; mission-by-mission beats, battles, objectives, optional branches, companion roles, failure rules, cinematic aftermath, unlock edges, and medal objectives remain to be decomposed.
Each stranger strand needs its individual numbered meetings, conditional branches, availability windows, collectibles, rewards and aftermath audited. Apparent part counts vary with framing scenes.
Special/Ultimate edition missions, unlocks and items need explicit original equivalents. Online-only and cut material must be tagged separately instead of silently included or omitted.
The random encounter index is not exhaustively itemized; every named event, sequence, region, time window, repeat occurrence and lasting consequence remains in scope.
Camp conversations, celebrations, activities, requests, rewards, songs, arguments and schedules are not exhaustively decomposed. The wiki camp-event page itself is under construction.

All 90 rank conditions now have individual records from indexed family articles. Detailed counters, resets, rewards, unlocks, original designs and runtime implementation remain open; the Horseman rank-2 reward is internally inconsistent in available source text.

13 indexed sheriff posters and 8 named captures across 7 owning missions are separately inventoried, including two optional targets absent from the category list. Full target stages, branches, edition history, deliveries, sheriff aftermath, home robberies, shop businesses, coach tips and hideout variants remain open.
Animal-family parents are not a full species inventory. Every compendium species, breed/coat, legendary variant, habitat, study/track/kill/skin state, animation and loot rule must be expanded.

All provisions, tonics, ingredients, ammunition variants, bait, lures, recipes, pamphlets, tools, equipment, clothing, hats, outfits, satchels, documents, cards, valuables, talismans, trinkets and unique rewards are not individually inventoried.
Major locations are inventoried; every smaller locality, interior, business, landmark, shack, grave, encounter area and point of interest remains in scope.

The prominent cast is inventoried; stranger patrons, debtors, bounty targets, gang members, merchants, service staff, lawmen, named ambient figures and mentioned/deceased personalities require separate expansion.
The entire campaign and post-story state graph, moral outcomes, attribute levels, focus abilities, equipment perks, economies and completion trackers require implemented-and-played evidence.
No gameplay implementation was independently audited for this research ledger. Entries default to unimplemented until implementation links and runtime evidence are supplied.

Original assets, animations, environmental and musical direction, sound, readable UI, input parity, camera work, performance, accessibility and cross-browser/mobile verification remain completion gates.

The requested final boardroom report requires evidence from the finished game: approach, design choices, effort allocation, engine assessment, technology rationale, validation and full coverage reconciliation.
